:::{#exm-lempel-ziv-code}
#### The Lempel--Ziv code of a short message

<!-- no-figure: the example is a table of pairs -->

The code below follows @def-lempel-ziv-code
for the phrases of @exm-lempel-ziv-parsing.
It prints each phrase with its pair,
then the number of phrases
and the length in [bits](entropy.qmd#def-bit) of the code.

```{r}
#| label: lempel-ziv-code
phrase_length <- nchar(phrases)
prefixes <- substr(phrases, 1, phrase_length - 1)
positions <- match(prefixes, c("", phrases)) - 1
new_symbols <- substr(phrases, phrase_length, phrase_length)
data.frame(phrase = phrases, position = positions, symbol = new_symbols)
n_phrases <- length(phrases)
position_bits <- ceiling(log2(n_phrases))
code_bits <- n_phrases * (position_bits + 1)
c(phrases = n_phrases, code_bits = code_bits)
```

Each position takes $`r position_bits`$ bits,
and the code adds one more bit for each new symbol,
so the code has $`r code_bits`$ bits.
That is more than the $`r nchar(message_text)`$ bits of the message itself,
so a message this short is too short for the code to save anything.

:::
